deploymentEvidence.evidence: BscScan indexed exact-address name tag identifies BakerySwap: BakerySwap Router, attributed by explorer to a Kleros Curate submission; direct page request returned403. Sourcify supplies exact chain/address deployment identity and BakerySwapRouter source/ABI. Deployed router body matches pinned official BakeryProject source after CRLF normalization; no independent live runtime check or official deployed-address table retrieval is claimed.
limitations: Official docs.bakeryswap.org/contracts was unreachable. Former www.bakeryswap.org now serves a /lander redirect; frontend uses attributable official source repository rather than that domain.
Sourcify reports creation/runtime match, not exact_match. Protocol attribution is corroborated by exact source-body comparison, not a current financial-safety or activity guarantee.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full ABI copied from this exact chain/address Sourcify abi. Flattened deployed-source router body equals pinned official contract body after normalize CRLF to LF, take contract BakerySwapRouter through EOF, trim. Verified deployment library is authoritative for dependencies; no whole-repository identity claim or generic Uniswap ABI substitution.

functionInventory.reason: Exclude read-only getter or quote; not a transaction capability or a new read API.

Explicit token/token liquidity provision; pulls caller tokens by allowance, derives pair from immutable factory, may create it, enforces reserve-balancing minimums and deadline, mints LP to specified recipient.
Explicit token/BNB liquidity provision; pulls caller tokens, wraps required native msg.value through immutable WBNB, checks minimums/deadline, mints LP to recipient and refunds unused BNB to caller.

Explicit non-permit token/token removal; consumes specified caller LP allowance, burns LP to recipient and checks both output minimums and deadline.
Explicit non-permit token/BNB removal; consumes caller LP allowance, checks pair-burn minimums/deadline, unwraps calculated WBNB amount and sends tokens/native BNB to recipient.
Explicit non-permit fee-supporting token/BNB removal; checks burn-accounting minimums/deadline but transfers entire router token balance, so token minimum is not guaranteed net post-tax receipt.
Exclude signature-bearing LP permit path and approveMax allowance authority; ordinary non-permit removal is selected independently.
Exclude signature-bearing LP permit path and approveMax allowance authority; ordinary non-permit removal is selected independently.
Exclude signature-bearing LP permit path and approveMax allowance authority; ordinary non-permit removal is selected independently.
Explicit exact-output native-BNB/token path swap; checks requested output, deadline and msg.value ceiling, wraps required input and refunds surplus BNB to caller.
Explicit exact-input native-BNB/token path swap; wraps msg.value, requires WBNB path start, checks output minimum/deadline and pays specified recipient.
Explicit exact-input native-BNB/token fee-supporting path swap; wraps msg.value, checks WBNB path start/deadline and recipient balance increase against minimum.
Explicit exact-input token/native-BNB path swap; pulls caller allowance-bounded input, requires WBNB path end, checks minimum/deadline and unwraps calculated output to recipient.
Explicit exact-input token/native-BNB fee-supporting swap; pulls caller amount, requires WBNB path end/deadline and checks minimum against entire router WBNB balance before unwrap/payment.
Explicit exact-input token path swap; pulls caller amount using allowance, checks minimum/deadline and derives pair calls from immutable factory and token path.
Explicit exact-input token fee-supporting path swap; pulls caller amount, computes hops using pair balances, checks recipient token balance delta against minimum and enforces deadline.
Explicit exact-output token/native-BNB swap; pulls calculated caller input under maximum, requires WBNB path end/deadline and unwraps specified output to recipient.
Explicit exact-output token path swap; pulls calculated caller input under maximum and enforces deadline; no opaque executor or arbitrary payload.
